reading.zh: 每个脚本产出一族实测数字：前三个在仿真里（风扰/EKF、悬停精度、legacy 与 velocity 两条执行路径对照），后两个量硬件与视觉（机械臂/控制延迟、检测吞吐）。注意 sim-mode-bench 的结论是仿真证据，不能当真机性能。
reading.en: Each script produces one family of measured numbers: the first three live in simulation (wind/EKF, hover accuracy, and the legacy-versus-velocity execution-path comparison), the last two measure hardware and vision (arm/control latency, detection throughput). Note sim-mode-bench is simulation evidence, not hardware performance.
